target.title: test(cloud-workers): milestone-2 fault-injection exit gate
target.body:
Part of #104294 (cloud workers, milestone 2 EXIT GATE, PR 10). **Stacked on #105865 (PR 9 openclaw worker mode)** — review/merge after PR 9; base will retarget to main once PR 9 lands.

## What Problem This Solves

The plan's milestone-2 exit criterion: "Fault-injection tests (tunnel partition, gateway restart, worker death) gate exit." This PR is that gate — a fault-injection suite proving the composed worker session (worker mode + the four backend RPCs) survives the failure modes a real cloud box hits, before milestone 3 builds dispatch/UI on top.

## Why This Change Was Made

`src/worker/worker.fault-injection.test.ts` drives the REAL worker runtime + RPC clients against a REAL in-process gateway (actual WebSocket server, the real gateway RPC dispatcher, real SQLite transcript/inference ledgers) — not lenient fakes — and injects transport-level faults:

- **Tunnel partition mid-turn** (socket dropped during a transcript commit / mid-inference-stream / with unacked live events; repeated partitions in one turn): on reconnect, transcript resumes from base leaf with no duplicate commit (ledger dedupe), inference resumes via durable replay with exactly one provider call (no double-bill), live events replay only the unacked tail.
- **Gateway restart** (in-memory state lost, durable SQLite survives): transcript commits replay idempotently from the ledger; an in-flight inference turn recovers per the landed semantics without re-executing the provider; live-event window resets are absorbed by the worker's lossy-degradation/renumber path without aborting the run.
- **Worker death / lease reclaim**: the old worker's in-flight operations are fenced at the higher owner epoch (cannot commit/emit/infer after supersession); a fresh worker admits at the new epoch and resumes from the durable transcript base leaf; no duplicate/lost entries and no double-bill across the handoff.
- **Edges**: epoch flip during an in-flight inference turn; reconnect during a commit that then hits stale-base-leaf (clean fail-stop, no dup); SIGINT/stop during an in-flight commit (bounded completion — the F1 no-spin fix).

Real product bugs found: none — the composed system survives all injected faults. This PR adds tests only; no product code changes.

## User Impact

None (tests only). Establishes the milestone-2 exit gate.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox: fault-injection suite green, plus the full worker (46/46) and gateway worker-environments (744/744) matrices and lint-suppressions. Type-aware + plain oxlint, check:test-types, madge zero cycles, fresh autoreview clean.
